obligations.expected_behavior: When a verdict is produced, it traces to the current source identity.
forbidden_result: A verdict is produced without traceability to the current source identity.
obligations.observable_result: The verdict has an evidentiary trace to the current source identity.
obligations.state_after: Each verdict is traceable to the current source identity.
obligations.state_before: A verdict may lack traceability to the current source identity.
obligations.subject: Verdict source provenance

obligations.expected_behavior: When a verdict is produced, it traces to real execution.
forbidden_result: A verdict is produced without traceability to real execution.
obligations.observable_result: The verdict has an evidentiary trace to real execution.
obligations.state_after: Each verdict is traceable to real execution.
obligations.state_before: A verdict may lack traceability to real execution.
obligations.subject: Verdict execution provenance

obligations.expected_behavior: Verdict support relies on current source identity and real execution rather than assistant prose.
forbidden_result: Assistant prose is used as the evidentiary basis for a verdict.
A verdict is accepted solely because of assistant prose.
obligations.observable_result: The verdict's supporting basis is source identity and real execution, with no assistant prose serving as the evidence.
obligations.state_after: Assistant prose is not the evidentiary basis for any verdict.
obligations.state_before: A verdict may be supported by assistant prose instead of current source identity and real execution.
obligations.subject: Verdict evidence basis
obligations.trigger: A verdict is produced or evaluated.
